discovery_rule.name: NETSTREAM - Descoberta de PONs GPON FiberHome

trigger_prototype.expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}].last()}=0 and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}].count(180)}>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: Queda total de ONUs

trigger_prototype.expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.gpon.pon.calc.dg.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}].delta(900)}>=3 and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.gpon.pon.calc.dg.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}].count(180)}>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: DyingGasp detectado (Energia)

trigger_prototype.expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}].delta(900)}>=3 and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}].count(180)}>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: LOS detectado (Fibra)
trigger_prototype.description: 3 ou mais ONUs passaram a ter LOS como motivo de queda nos ultimos 15 minutos. Possivel rompimento de fibra na PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}.

trigger_prototype.expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}].change()}<-{$GPON_DROP_MIN} and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}].last()}>0 and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.fiberhome[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}].count(180)}>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: Queda parcial de ONUs
Uplink {#IFDESC} - Alto volume de drops de entrada (>10/s por 5min)
Uplink {#IFDESC} - Alto volume de drops de saida (>10/s por 5min)

trigger_prototype.expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}].max(#3)}=2 and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}].diff()}=1 and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}].count(10m)}>1
trigger_prototype.name: Uplink {#IFDESC}: Link DOWN

trigger_prototype.expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.uplink.ifspeed[{#SNMPINDEX}].last()}>0 and (({Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.uplink.in.bps[{#SNMPINDEX}].min(5m)}/{Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.uplink.ifspeed[{#SNMPINDEX}].last()})>0.9 or ({Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.uplink.out.bps[{#SNMPINDEX}].min(5m)}/{Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:netstream.uplink.ifspeed[{#SNMPINDEX}].last()})>0.9)
trigger_prototype.name: Uplink {#IFDESC}: Consumo acima de 90% da porta por 5min

trigger_prototype.expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:state.onu.[{#SNMPINDEX}.{#ONUSN}.{#ONTDESC}].last()}=0 or {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:state.onu.[{#SNMPINDEX}.{#ONUSN}.{#ONTDESC}].last()}=4
trigger_prototype.recovery_expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:state.onu.[{#SNMPINDEX}.{#ONUSN}.{#ONTDESC}].last(#3)}=1 and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:onuPonRXOpticalPowerdedicado.["{#SNMPINDEX}"].last()}<0
trigger_prototype.name: Cliente - {#ONTDESC}

trigger_prototype.expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:state.onu.[{#SNMPINDEX}.{#ONUSN}.{#ONTDESC}].last()}=1 and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:onuPonRXOpticalPowerdedicado.["{#SNMPINDEX}"].last()}<-28
trigger_prototype.recovery_expression: {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:state.onu.[{#SNMPINDEX}.{#ONUSN}.{#ONTDESC}].last()}=1 and {Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:onuPonRXOpticalPowerdedicado.["{#SNMPINDEX}"].last()}>-28
trigger_prototype.name: Cliente - {#ONTDESC} - Sinal RX Baixo

trigger_prototype.expression: ({Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:oltPonOnlineStatus[{#SNMPVALUE}].last(,1m)}=0)and({Template SNMP OLT FiberHome - NETSTREAM:oltPonAuthOnuNum[{#SNMPVALUE}].prev()}>2)
trigger_prototype.name: gpon_{#SNMPVALUE}:
